title: Almost every segment meets a Lebesgue-null set in a null set of parameters
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and N ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n) a measurable set with Lⁿ(N) = 0. Then for Lⁿ⊗Lⁿ-almost every p = (x, y) ∈ ℝⁿ × ℝⁿ (the measure volume on Euclid n × Euclid n), and for L¹-almost every t ∈ [0, 1], (1 − t)y + tx ∉ N.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid n)), MeasurableSet N → volume N = 0 → ∀ᵐ p : Euclid n × Euclid n, ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)), (1 - t) • p.2 + t • p.1 ∉ N
